title: Service account creation flow with attestation, owner lifecycle, and least-privilege templates
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Service account (SA) creation at Redwood is currently fragmented: ad-hoc permission grants, unclear owner assignments, and inconsistent TTL/rotation practices. This creates audit gaps and increases blast radius when a SA is compromised. Existing templates are inconsistent across repos and teams, and we lack a standard attestation step that ties SA issuance to an accountable owner and a documented justification.

Proposal: Implement a single opinionated creation flow and catalog of least-privilege templates that integrates with RBAC v2 and audit logging. Key features: 1) Console + CLI creation flow (redwoodctl sa create) with required owner attestation (saml group or user), reason, and TTL. 2) Canonical template catalog: environment-scoped templates (prod/read-only, prod/limited-writes, infra-deploy, monitoring-exporter) expressed as RBAC v2 policy fingerprints. 3) Enforced owner lifecycle: owners receive periodic ownership confirmation prompts and must attest or reassign; default TTL with automatic expiry and rotation path. 4) Audit metadata: every SA creation includes structured audit fields (template_id, owner_id, justification, ttl, creation_channel) surfaced to Console and sent to central audit logs. 5) CLI/API-first for infra automation and a conservative Console UX for manual creation. 6) Backward-compatible migration helpers to map existing SAs to templates and require owners to claim unowned SAs. 7) Integration points for SSO/SAML group mapping to bootstrap owners and for security_review_required flags to kick off manual review flows.

Goals and acceptance criteria: - Creation flow enforces owner field and justification in >95% of new SAs. - At least 6 production-ready least-privilege templates published and reviewed by security. - Audit events for SA lifecycle (create/claim/renew/expire/rotate/revoke) emitted with required fields and visible in Console audit timeline. - Migration tool identifies and assigns owners for >=90% of existing SAs with recommended templates. - UI and CLI implementations include granular permission checks so only allowed roles can create SAs with specific templates.

Out of scope for this ticket: full RBAC v2 engine rollout (this ticket uses RBAC v2 primitives already implemented by ENG-51800). Long-term token management/rotation service will be a follow-up (see dependencies).
updates: 2026-02-17: Kickoff meeting with Product (R. Kim), Security (A. Martinez), and Platform (L. O'Connor). Agreed on owner attestation requirement and TTL defaults (30d for low-risk, 7d for prod write scopes). Notes: https://confluence.redwood/SA-attestation-kickoff (draft).

2026-02-25: Drafted template catalog spec and RBAC v2 mapping. Put initial templates in Google Drive: /design/sa_templates_v1.xlsx. Asked Security to review for least-privilege gaps (A. Martinez assigned).
2026-03-02: Architecture diagram completed. Architecture PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 (runtime + control-plane changes).

2026-03-05: UX mockups (Console flow) available in Figma: https://figma.com/file/sa-creation-flow. Preliminary feedback from PM and DX: show required audit fields inline and a claim-by checkbox. UX changes tracked under DES-7012 (design follow-up).

2026-03-08: Security review request submitted. Security requested an explicit owners-rotation policy and an audit retention spec. Follow-up action: add explicit 'claim window' for orphaned SAs (14 days) before auto-revocation.
notes:
Migration approach: run a discovery job to surface unowned SAs, compute best-fit template via permission fingerprinting, and create claim tickets assigned to tentative owners. We'll provide a one-click claim in the Console and a bulk-claim CLI for infra teams. Audit events will include pre- and post-migration mappings.

Rollout plan: 1) Internal beta for platform teams (2 weeks), 2) Canary for low-risk product namespaces, 3) Full enforcement gate after 6 weeks and security sign-off.

Links: Design spec draft: https://confluence.redwood/sa-templates-spec. GitHub PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821. Figma: https://figma.com/file/sa-creation-flow. KPIs dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood/d/sa-usage-kpis.
